rules.text: Returns: unworn items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
Returns, outerwear: jackets and shells can be returned within 14 days of delivery.
Returns are started by email to returns@sallowfen.example with the order number.
Shipping: orders of 50 dollars or more ship free within the US.
Warranty, footwear: boots and shoes are covered against defects for 24 months.
Price protection: if the price drops within 7 days of purchase, we refund the difference.
Exchanges: a different size or colour can be exchanged within 60 days of delivery.
Damaged on arrival: we send a free replacement; the customer does not need to return the item.
Summer sale: 20 percent off all tents until 31 August.
Support hours: Monday to Friday, 8 am to 6 pm Mountain time.

changes.text: Shipping: free US shipping on any order of 50 dollars or more.
Returns are started at sallowfen.example/returns with the order number; the email address is retired.
Price protection: if the price drops within 14 days of purchase, we refund the difference.
Warranty, footwear: boots and shoes have a 24-month warranty against manufacturing defects.

rule.text: Gift cards: gift cards cannot be returned or refunded.
Loyalty: members earn 1 point per dollar; 100 points is a 5 dollar credit.

questions.ask: Can a customer return a rain jacket delivered 20 days ago?
Does a 60 dollar order of camping gear ship free?
Are 18-month-old hiking boots with a split sole under warranty?
A jacket dropped in price 10 days after purchase. Do we refund the difference?
Can a customer exchange boots for a larger size 45 days after delivery?
Can a customer return an unused gift card?

A.title: A · diff the time window in fact trace
A.how: every fact id (today's `fact list` plus the ids eval 1 logged), `fact trace` each, keep the entries after eval 1; a changed answer is blamed on the entries on its topic

B.title: B · diff two full snapshots
B.how: eval 1 saved the whole `fact list` (text, metadata, updated_at); compare it with today's; a changed answer is blamed on the changes on its topic

C.title: C · diff the memory the answer read
C.how: every answer saved a receipt: the facts it read, as it read them; compare the two receipts of a changed answer, then replay the agent with one changed fact at a time put back to its eval-1 version
